renderers.name: ANGLE GLES 3.0
renderers.description: Uses the unified OpenGL ES 3 renderer through the best ANGLE driver available on each platform.
renderers.summary: Recommended for consistent cross-platform behavior and a smaller testing matrix.

renderers.name: OpenGL 3.2 + OpenGL ES 3.0
renderers.description: Uses native OpenGL 3.2 on desktop platforms and OpenGL ES on mobile platforms.
renderers.summary: May improve performance in some desktop workloads, but requires broader driver and platform testing.

renderers.name: OpenGL 4.1 + OpenGL ES 3.0
renderers.description: Uses native OpenGL 4.1 on desktop platforms and OpenGL ES on mobile platforms.
renderers.summary: May expose more desktop graphics features, with additional compatibility testing required.

renderers.name: OpenGL 4.3 + OpenGL ES 3.0
renderers.description: Uses native OpenGL 4.3 on Windows and Linux and OpenGL ES on mobile platforms.
renderers.summary: Intended for projects that need newer desktop OpenGL and can test a wider range of drivers.

renderers.name: OpenGL 4.5 + OpenGL ES 3.0
renderers.description: Uses native OpenGL 4.5 on Windows and Linux and OpenGL ES on mobile platforms.
renderers.summary: Provides the newest selectable desktop OpenGL target and needs the broadest compatibility testing.

coreModules.name: Effects
coreModules.description: Particle effects, post-processing filters, water, shadows, light scattering and related visual effects.

coreModules.name: JBullet
coreModules.description: Rigid-body physics integration using the pure-Java JBullet backend.

coreModules.name: Networking
coreModules.description: SpiderMonkey client/server networking, message serialization and hosted services.

coreModules.name: Nifty GUI
coreModules.description: Integration between jMonkeyEngine and the Nifty GUI toolkit.

coreModules.name: Asset plugins
coreModules.description: Additional asset loaders and importers for common model, scene and image formats.

coreModules.name: Terrain
coreModules.description: Terrain rendering, level-of-detail control, height maps and terrain utilities.

coreModules.name: Test Data
coreModules.description: Assets used by jMonkeyEngine examples and tests. Useful for prototyping, but not intended for production distribution.

coreModules.name: AWT Settings Launcher
coreModules.description: Shows the desktop settings dialog before launch and provides AWT-based error dialogs.

allocators.name: Safe Native Allocator
allocators.description: Cross-platform hardened native allocator with better memory management.

allocators.name: Platform Allocator
allocators.description: Uses the allocator supplied by each platform backend. It can be faster with lower overhead in some workloads, but is less secure.

iosLegacy.name: Legacy
iosLegacy.description: Use the native legacy OpenGL ES bindings instead of ANGLE. This can be faster on older devices, but the API is deprecated by Apple.
